evidence.title: GitHub - raphaelsalaja/skill: A skill file based on the articles written on userinterface.wiki. · GitHub

name: 12-principles-of-animation
summary: Agent skill that reviews web animation code against Disney's 12 animation principles adapted for interfaces.
description: A portable SKILL.md package for coding agents: point it at animation code and it checks every motion against Disney's 12 principles adapted for the web, in four rule categories — timing, easing, physics and staging (300ms interaction limits, ease-out entrances, spring overshoot, stagger caps, one focal point). Findings are reported as file:line plus a summary table. The skill is based on articles from userinterface.wiki and installs with the skills CLI from the raphaelsalaja/skill repo.
contains: rule categories: timing, easing, physics, staging
rules: 300ms limit, ease-out entrance, ease-in exit, spring overshoot, stagger cap, focal point
outputs findings in file:line format with a summary table
installs with npx skills add from the raphaelsalaja/skill repo
references: The Illusion of Life; Apple WWDC23 Animate with Springs
